global: light orchestral with pizzicato, accordion and glockenspiel

sections.name: hook
sections.style: cheeky bouncy pizzicato with a quirky accordion riff, rising excitement, a little cartoon whoosh energy

sections.name: setting
sections.style: calm cosy library groove, soft brushed snare, gentle celesta and upright bass, studious and warm

sections.name: rising
sections.style: building comedic tension, ticking pizzicato ostinato getting faster, marimba runs, nervous and busy

sections.name: crash
sections.style: comic alarm stab, cartoon brass hit then chaotic tumbling woodwinds

sections.name: deadpan
sections.style: sparse deadpan comic plunks, a lonely accordion phrase, quiet, then a sneaky low tuba sting

sections.name: bots
sections.style: sneaky mischievous robot march, bouncy tuba and bassoon, bleepy synth accents, playful heist feel

sections.name: fight
sections.style: determined comic standoff, staccato strings and snare, a heroic little brass fanfare

sections.name: finale
sections.style: warm gentle nordic folk ending, solo accordion and soft strings, wistful and sweet, then a tiny comic plink button
